changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The mentor's per-account serialization row, and what each request version admitted and how its delivery is fenced. No release has the mentor tables yet, and nothing writes these before the release that registers them in the person-data inventory. The new columns still only expand, as every migration does.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE public.mentor_request ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_request_delivery_fence CHECK (delivery_fence IN ('STOPPED', 'SOURCE_DELETED', 'SOURCE_EDITED')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_request_end_reason CHECK (end_reason IN ('STOPPED', 'SOURCE_DELETED'));
-- A Stop by someone else than the owner records NOT_OWNER. No release recorded STOP_NOT_HANDLED, because no release -- has the table, so the list drops it. ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_reason, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_reason CHECK (reason IN ('UNAUTHORIZED', 'AUTHOR_MISMATCH', 'ALREADY_OPENED', 'NO_REQUEST', 'STALE_REVISION', 'SOURCE_DELETED', 'REQUEST_SETTLED', 'NOT_OWNER'));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE public.mentor_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_reason, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_event_reason CHECK (reason IN ('UNAUTHORIZED', 'AUTHOR_MISMATCH', 'ALREADY_OPENED', 'NO_REQUEST', 'STALE_REVISION', 'SOURCE_DELETED', 'REQUEST_SETTLED', 'STOP_NOT_HANDLED'))

ALTER TABLE public.mentor_request DROP COLUMN settled_at, DROP COLUMN end_reason, DROP COLUMN delivery_fence, DROP COLUMN delivery_generation, DROP COLUMN admitted_source_ref, DROP COLUMN admitted_revision
